propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase must consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` and cite registered code-health-lens metric values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as durable trend evidence
rebar metrics output includes four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and an unavailable state that agents must distinguish from zero
project documentation must reference rebar metrics surface in user-guide.md, AGENTS.md, and reuse-surface.md so contributors and tools can discover it
examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/phases/discovery.md must guide subagents to run rebar metrics and handle the unavailable state for metrics whose signal has not yet accrued
